tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: App background behind the board and the daily-note panel. Also the fill of the compiled note block and the completed-section divider.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Board, panel, header cells, plan cards, inputs. The base that experiment lane tints are mixed into.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for buttons, plan rows and header cells; empty progress-bar track.

tokens.name: bg-day-done
tokens.usage: Every cell of a day column whose plans are all done. Overrides the experiment lane tint.

tokens.name: bg-head-done
tokens.usage: Day header cell when that day is fully done.

tokens.name: bg-card-done
tokens.usage: Plan card whose plans in that one cell are all done.

tokens.name: bg-completed-lane
tokens.usage: Lane fill for experiments in the Completed section (replaces the color tint).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Board and panel outline, sticky name-column edge, header bottoms.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Button and input borders (3:1 against bg-surface).

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between day cells; stays faint over any lane tint.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, experiment names, day numbers. Legible on every surface above in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary headings: section titles in the daily note, ghost-row title.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta text: weekday, step counts, week ranges, eyebrows, hints. 5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: done-ink
tokens.usage: Text and checkbox fill of a crossed-off plan (always with line-through). 4.7:1 even on bg-day-done.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Today marker, selection ring, drop-target outline, focus ring, primary button, progress fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (today number, primary button).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected plan background; ghost-row selected day; drop-target cell fill.

tokens.name: inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Selection toolbar and the app mark tile.

tokens.name: inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse-bg.

tokens.name: inverse-border
tokens.usage: Button outlines inside the selection toolbar.

tokens.name: cat-tc
tokens.usage: TC (tissue culture) plans: font color and tag. Tag TC.

tokens.name: cat-clone
tokens.usage: Cloning plans. Tag CL.

tokens.name: cat-mouse
tokens.usage: Mouse work plans. Tag MS.

tokens.name: cat-flow
tokens.usage: Flow cytometry plans. Tag FL.

tokens.name: cat-sort
tokens.usage: Sorting (FACS) plans. Tag SO.

tokens.name: cat-analysis
tokens.usage: Analysis plans. Tag AN. Grouped under Analysis in the daily note.

tokens.name: cat-slides
tokens.usage: Slide-making plans. Tag SL. Grouped under Slides in the daily note.

tokens.name: cat-meeting
tokens.usage: Meetings. Tag MT. Grouped under Meetings in the daily note.

tokens.name: cat-custom-1
tokens.usage: First user-defined category (example: PCR / NGS).

tokens.name: cat-custom-2
tokens.usage: Second user-defined category.

tokens.name: cat-custom-3
tokens.usage: Third user-defined category.

tokens.name: cat-custom-4
tokens.usage: Fourth user-defined category.

tokens.name: cat-custom-5
tokens.usage: Fifth user-defined category.

tokens.name: cat-custom-6
tokens.usage: Sixth user-defined category; after six, cycle from custom-1.

tokens.name: exp-red
tokens.usage: Experiment color (Google Docs preset, light red 1). Swatch fill; lane = 16% of it over bg-surface. Never a text color.

tokens.name: exp-orange
tokens.usage: Experiment color (light orange 1).

tokens.name: exp-yellow
tokens.usage: Experiment color (light yellow 1).

tokens.name: exp-green
tokens.usage: Experiment color (light green 1).

tokens.name: exp-cyan
tokens.usage: Experiment color (light cyan 1).

tokens.name: exp-blue
tokens.usage: Experiment color (light blue 1).

tokens.name: exp-purple
tokens.usage: Experiment color (light purple 1).

tokens.name: exp-magenta
tokens.usage: Experiment color (light magenta 1).

tokens.name: exp-red-deep
tokens.usage: Experiment color (Google Docs dark red 1).

tokens.name: exp-orange-deep
tokens.usage: Experiment color (dark orange 1).

tokens.name: exp-yellow-deep
tokens.usage: Experiment color (dark yellow 1).

tokens.name: exp-green-deep
tokens.usage: Experiment color (dark green 1).

tokens.name: exp-cyan-deep
tokens.usage: Experiment color (dark cyan 1).

tokens.name: exp-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Experiment color (dark blue 1).

tokens.name: exp-purple-deep
tokens.usage: Experiment color (dark purple 1).

tokens.name: exp-magenta-deep
tokens.usage: Experiment color (dark magenta 1).

tokens.name: exp-desk
tokens.usage: The pinned Desk & meetings row. Not offered in the picker.

styles.name: day-number
styles.usage: Date number in a day header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Puro at 2 µg/mL; check viability Fri.

styles.name: exp-name
styles.usage: Experiment name in the sticky column.

styles.name: plan
styles.usage: A plan line inside a card. Colored by its category.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Step counts, week ranges, experiment name under a summary item.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels: Daily note, Completed, Experiments.

styles.name: tag
styles.sample: TC CL MS FL SO AN
styles.usage: Two-letter category tag before each plan; ISO week labels (W43).

styles.name: day-offset
styles.usage: Days since the experiment's first plan, top of each card; day header progress (2/5).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between plan lines; palette swatch gap; selection-toolbar button gap.

tokens.name: space-cell
tokens.usage: Day-cell padding and gap between stacked cards; checkbox-to-tag gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps; gap between daily-note rows; name-row icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Name-cell horizontal padding; header item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between board and panel; minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page top padding; panel inner padding is 18px (space-4 + 2).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, palette swatch, inline rename input.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Plan row hover/selection, add (+) button, add-step form fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, plan cards, today number, palette tray.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Board and daily-note panel; app mark tile is 10px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Category chips, progress bar.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of the roadmap grid.

tokens.name: col-name
tokens.usage: Sticky experiment-name column.

tokens.name: col-day-compact
tokens.usage: Day column, compact density. A three-to-four-word step still fits on one line.

tokens.name: col-day
tokens.usage: Day column, default density. Sized so a short sentence (about 26 characters at the plan style, e.g. "Transduce library, MOI 0.3") fits with its checkbox and tag.

tokens.name: col-day-roomy
tokens.usage: Day column, roomy density, for longer step descriptions.

tokens.name: col-day-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest a person can drag the shared day-column width.

tokens.name: col-day-max
tokens.usage: Widest a person can drag the shared day-column width.

tokens.name: col-name-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest drag width of the experiment-name column.

tokens.name: col-name-max
tokens.usage: Widest drag width of the experiment-name column.

tokens.name: cell-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a lane cell; the lane grows to its tallest card.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and day-navigation controls.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small buttons, fields in the legend and ghost row.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Daily-note panel maximum width (flex-basis 330px).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Plan cards only. Done cards drop it.
